text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a fine afternoon day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly have the urge to go shopping
somewhere I haven't been to
before.
Along the way though, I get myself
completely lost...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I'm sorry to intrude.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you happen to be a trainer at
Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it. I believe I've seen you at
school several times. I
recognized your
face.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, you seem to be having some
difficulties. What troubles
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grateful for Grass Wonder's concern, I
explain that it's my first time in
the area
and I've gotten lost.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, that's a predicament indeed!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you do not object,
I would be pleased to
guide you to the school.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I was just on my way back, and
as they say, "No road is
long with good
company." ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I often come this way to buy items for my
hobby, so I'm familiar with
the area. Just
leave everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the generous student up on her
offer, and we walk at a relaxed
pace
toward the academy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We're almost there now. Tracen is
only a short distance from
here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, the sun is already setting. I must
have been walking too
leisurely... Forgive
me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? You must have an
appreciation for the fleeting nature of

things.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...When the evening comes, the sky
remains beautiful, its crimson
hues
ever-changing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I could keep on watching forever... I'm
afraid that's what kept me at
such a
dallying pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Grass Wonder voices these musings, we
come to a halt and gaze
together at the
sky above. But suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, could it be?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, not to worry. It was a long walk. You must be famished.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Here, I have the perfect thing for that.
May I trouble you for a bit
more of your
time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I would be pleased to thank
you by performing a
Nodate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, an open-air tea ceremony. It's the
elegant tradition of enjoying
tea while
feeling the warm sunlight and fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Tea ceremony is one of my hobbies. I
made the long journey today to
order
matcha tea and sweets at my favorite
store.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have all the necessary items with me.
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful. ♪ Then I'll get everything
ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder performs the ceremony, and
we enjoy some delicious
tea and fine
sweets.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How was it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Heehee, I'm glad to hear that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The wonder and joy of tea is in its
ability
to satisfy both the body and
soul.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, since I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Tea ceremony, flower arrangement,
calligraphy, Japanese dance...
And a bit of
the naginata polearm as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they're just hobbies of mine that I
take immense pleasure in
indulging.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was born in America, but both my parents
dearly love Japan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They explained the elegance of Japanese
culture to me often... So I
naturally came
to have an interest in it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There were fine instructors back home,
so I
asked my parents to let
me learn all that I
could.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, that I do!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I owe many important lessons to it—from
civility and sincerity, to
consideration for
others.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though of course, I yet have much to
learn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I train every day to be polite and
refined—to one day reach the
Japanese
ideal of Yamato Nadeshiko.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm sorry. I've been going on and on
about myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's make our way back to the
academy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we part ways, I return to my room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder, the polite and refined
student. I wonder what a racer
who serves
tea ceremonies and smiles so peacefully
can run like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little did I know, my answer was to come
much sooner than expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Notice to all trainers regarding the
upcoming tryouts."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I receive an email containing the list of
participants, and Grass
Wonder's name
immediately catches my eye.
